Compute choice

The raw virtual machines and the platform that deploys them for you.

1. Core Concept

  • EC2 gives you total control over the OS and hardware specs. Elastic Beanstalk takes your code and provisions the EC2, Load Balancers, and ASGs automatically.

2. Key Services & Features

  • EC2 Pricing Models:
    • On-Demand: Pay by the second. No commitment.
    • Spot: Up to 90% off, but AWS can reclaim it with 2 minutes notice.
    • Reserved Instances: 1-3 year commitment for steady workloads.
    • Dedicated Hosts: Physical server for licensing compliance.
  • Elastic Beanstalk:
    • PaaS for web apps (Java, Node, Python).
    • You only manage code; AWS provisions capacity, load balancing, and scaling.
    • You retain full root access to the EC2 instances.

3. Architecture Rules

  • Never use Spot instances for stateful, critical, or inflexible workloads.
  • Decouple state from EC2 instances (use S3 or EFS) so instances can be terminated without data loss.

4. Scenarios & Use Cases

  • A massive batch processing job runs nightly, can be interrupted, and needs to be as cheap as possible.
    • Choose: EC2 Spot Instances.
    • Why: The workload is fault-tolerant and flexible, perfectly matching Spot's aggressive discounts.
  • A dev team wants to deploy a Node.js web app without managing infrastructure, but keep OS access.
    • Choose: Elastic Beanstalk.
    • Why: It handles the deployment pipeline but still provisions visible, accessible EC2 instances.
